title: Hydra's Heads
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: A knight fights a creature with H heads and T tails and may cut one head, one tail, two heads or two tails, but cutting a single head regrows a head, cutting a single tail regrows two tails, and cutting two tails grows a head. The creature dies only when both counts reach zero at once; the task is the fewest cuts, with H and T each at most 100.
